newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem $75 mln debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem $75 mln debenture issue.

text.p: Freddie Mac said Wednesday that on May 23 it will redeem the entire $75 million principal amount of its 7.68 percent fixed-rate debenture issue.
The debentures were set to mature May 23, 2001. They will be redeemed at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount.
Payment of principal plus interest accrued to the redemption date will be made to shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 22, 1997, Freddie Mac said.
Freddie Mac is a corporation chartered by Congress that buys mortgages from lenders and packages them into securities for investors.
